scope_statement: Label-blind local feasibility only: output shape, licensing, serialization safety, repeatability, runtime and peak memory on frozen development clips. No accuracy claim, no threshold, no selection, no held-out access, no audio sent off this machine.

segmentation_free_gop.implementation: independent implementation of the published CC BY 4.0 equations (arXiv 2507.16838) in speech_sound_patterns/sfgop.py; no unlicensed repository code; no SpeechOcean-trained scoring head
segmentation_free_gop.model: frozen Meta ONNX wav2vec2 espeak model, revision c69750f5043e5e1f8a71ab95dd3b98338c280c92, verified via benchmark-repair-meta-contract-v1.0.0.json
segmentation_free_gop.correctness_evidence: junction likelihoods proven equal to brute-force CTC path enumeration at nine decimal places in tests, including repeated-label, multi-token, whole-sequence and deletion edge cases; per-target junction self-checks and forward-backward consistency checks passed with zero absolute difference on all real clips
segmentation_free_gop.output_semantics: per scorable consonant span: GOP-AF and GOP-AF-SD log posteriors, deletion posterior and top alternative candidate phones; concern and alternative-candidate evidence only, never truth

powsm.environment: isolated venv pinned in environments/powsm-21ffa41-pip.txt (espnet 202511, torch 2.8.0, cpu)
powsm.serialization_audit: checkpoint pickle audited opcode by opcode before load; observed globals limited to collections OrderedDict, torch FloatStorage and torch._utils._rebuild_tensor_v2; anything else fails closed
powsm.inference_settings: task <pr>, lang <eng>, beam size 1, cpu, 20 second window, text_prev <na>
powsm.lineage_limits: IPAPack++ training with G2P-derived labels; SpeechOcean762 and L2-ARCTIC are evaluation-only for this model; agreement with ZIPA can never be treated as independent confirmation
powsm.environment_notes: espnet package import fetched nltk tagger data once during environment setup; inference runs with SPEECH_SOUND_OFFLINE and HF_HUB_OFFLINE enforced

wav2vec2_commonphone.harness_provenance: architecture and IPA symbol table adapted from the CC0-1.0 repository github.com/PKlumpp/phd_model at commit dfff4848baf1a6698c245e83f8768a577c353558
wav2vec2_commonphone.serialization_audit: safetensors only; the repository's pickle weights file was never downloaded or loaded; safetensors header parsed without tensor loading and the 102 by 1024 head verified before use
wav2vec2_commonphone.environment: isolated venv pinned in environments/commonphone-e856cb9-pip.txt (torch 2.8.0, transformers 4.57.6, cpu)
wav2vec2_commonphone.independence_limits: trained on Common Phone, derived from Common Voice; this project's Common Phone and Australian Common Voice evidence are non-independent of the model and can never count toward its selection gates, headline results or corroboration

zipa.reason: model weight licence and provenance confirmation from the authors is still pending; the fail-closed provider register refuses the lane until it is resolved

unsw_speech_attributes.reason: checkpoint licence and training-data rights are unresolved pending the combined UNSW enquiry; no checkpoint was downloaded or loaded

child_phoneme_model.reason: exact OpenRAIL conditions and MyST and Providence derived-weight rights are unreviewed; no checkpoint was downloaded or loaded

evidence_class_separation: segmentation-free GOP expected-phone concern evidence, unconstrained free-phone recognition evidence and articulatory attribute evidence remain separate classes; none is truth and agreement between classes is not confirmation
no_selection_notice: feasibility establishes only that admitted candidates run, repeat and are legally usable for their declared roles on this machine; the frozen development and tuning comparison and its unchanged gates remain the only path to any selection
